w: In the evening assembly, Swamishri was honored from the Governor of Atlanta's office and also offered the 'Key to the City of Clarkstown' by Mayor George Baldesare of Clarkstown.
At 10.55 a.m. Swamishri arrived in Bhalej village. After performing pujan and arti of murtis at the Swaminarayan Mandir, Swamishri blessed the assembly and returned to Anand.
